Scholarship schemes of the Example State Education Department

The department runs the schemes below for school students. Read each scheme carefully before applying.

Pragati Scholarship for Girls

The scheme is open to girls studying in Class 11 at a government school in the state.

Each selected student receives Rs. 10,000 per annum.

Merit Scholarship for Class 9

Students of either gender studying in Class 9 who scored well in Class 8 may apply.

The award is Rs. 6,000 per annum.

Apply on the official website of the scheme.

Science Talent Award

Boys and girls studying in Class 12 with Science are eligible for this award.

Winners receive Rs. 20,000 once.
